title: AI and perception biases in investments: An experimental study
title_zh: 人工智能与投资中的认知偏差：一项实验研究
title_primary: 人工智能与投资中的认知偏差：一项实验研究
title_secondary: AI and perception biases in investments: An experimental study
authors: Anastassia Fedyk, Ali Kakhbod, Peiyao Li, Ulrike Malmendier
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: AI promises to accelerate and broaden access to automated investment advice. But can it capture the investment preferences and rationales of historically underrepresented investors? We ask 1272 human survey respondents and 1350 AI-generated agents to rate stocks, bonds, and cash. First, default AI-generated responses overrepresent young, high-income individuals. However, algorithmic bias is reduced with demographically-seeded prompts. Second, AI-generated free-form responses correctly reflect human rationales: risk and return, financial knowledge, and past experiences. Third, AI can help identify where a lack of financial knowledge poses issues in human responses, as shown in textual analyses of transitivity violations.

title: How to determine key players when spillovers are large
title_zh: 溢出效应显著时如何识别关键参与者
title_primary: 溢出效应显著时如何识别关键参与者
title_secondary: How to determine key players when spillovers are large
authors: Yves Zenou
official: 官方在线 2026-09-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the behavior of Katz–Bonacich centrality and key-player intercentrality in linear–quadratic network games when spillovers are strong. Understanding this regime is both theoretically important and empirically relevant in environments where interactions are intense. We show that as spillovers become large, Katz–Bonacich centrality converges (up to scale) to the Perron eigenvector, while intercentrality diverges at the same rate for all nodes and becomes dominated by a common leading component. As a result, first-order proportional differences in intercentrality—normalized by the common divergent scale—vanish near the critical threshold. Rankings based on lower-order differences in intercentrality, or on post-removal activity and welfare levels, need not collapse and may remain stable even arbitrarily close to the boundary.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在溢出效应较强时，线性二次网络博弈中Katz–Bonacich中心性与关键参与者间中心性的行为。理解这一机制在理论上具有重要意义，并且在互动密集的环境中具有实证相关性。我们证明，随着溢出效应增大，Katz–Bonacich中心性（按比例）收敛于Perron特征向量，而间中心性对所有节点以相同速率发散，并受一个共同的领先成分主导。因此，在临界阈值附近，以共同发散尺度归一化后的间中心性的一阶比例差异消失。基于间中心性低阶差异或基于移除后活动与福利水平的排序，则不必崩溃，并且即使在边界任意接近的情况下也可能保持稳定。

title: Labor unions and deaths of despair: Evidence from right-to-work laws
title_zh: 工会与绝望之死：来自工作权法的证据
title_primary: 工会与绝望之死：来自工作权法的证据
title_secondary: Labor unions and deaths of despair: Evidence from right-to-work laws
authors: Luke Petach
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between union membership and deaths of despair. Using state-level variation in the timing of the adoption of right-to-work laws as a natural experiment, I show that right-to-work laws are associated with a decline in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair. Two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) difference-in-differences (DiD) estimates suggest that the adoption of a right-to-work law is associated with a 2.6 percentage point reduction in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair mortality of 13 additional persons per 100,000, implying there are approximately 7.5 additional deaths of despair for every 1,000 workers who lose union membership. An analysis of mechanisms suggests the increase in mortality is largely driven by increased opioid usage and a concomitant increase in overdose deaths. I support the TWFE results with estimates from two alternative estimators robust to concerns about treatment effect heterogeneity and variation in treatment timing. Estimates from the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) estimator and the Borusyak et al. (2024) estimator support the TWFE findings: right-to-work laws reduce union membership and increase deaths of despair.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了工会会员身份与绝望死亡之间的关系。利用各州采纳工作权法时间上的差异作为自然实验，我表明工作权法与工会会员身份的下降及绝望死亡的增加相关联。双向固定效应（TWFE）双重差分（DiD）估计显示，采纳工作权法与工会会员身份降低2.6个百分点及绝望死亡死亡率每10万人增加13人相关，这意味着每1000名失去工会会员身份的工人中，大约有7.5例额外的绝望死亡。机制分析表明，死亡率的增加主要由阿片类药物使用增加及随之而来的过量死亡增加所驱动。我通过两种对处理效应异质性和处理时间变化具有稳健性的替代估计器来支持TWFE结果。来自Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021）估计器及Borusyak等人（2024）估计器的估计支持TWFE发现：工作权法减少了工会会员身份并增加了绝望死亡。

title: Firms, Flexibility, and Fertility
title_zh: 企业、灵活性与生育率
title_primary: 企业、灵活性与生育率
title_secondary: Firms, Flexibility, and Fertility
authors: Nezih Guner, Ezgi Kaya, Alessandro Ruggieri, Virginia Sánchez Marcos
official: 官方在线 2026-02-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of workplace flexibility on female labor market outcomes and fertility, with a particular focus on the Spanish labor market. Using a variety of data sources — including labor force surveys, time-use surveys, and administrative records — we document that rigid schedules, split-shift work arrangements, and long working hours increase the time cost of childcare, reducing women’s participation, wage growth, and career progression. Flexible arrangements, by contrast, facilitate work–family balance but are unevenly distributed across firms, sectors, and occupations. We present a simple model in which job inflexibility lowers both labor force participation and fertility, especially among mothers. We also provide a survey of the literature on the value of flexibility, the costs of family-friendly policies, and equilibrium models linking firm behavior to fertility decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了工作场所灵活性对女性劳动力市场结果及生育率的影响，特别聚焦于西班牙劳动力市场。利用多种数据来源——包括劳动力调查、时间使用调查及行政记录——我们记录了固定工时、分班工作安排及长时间工作增加了育儿的时间成本，从而降低了女性的劳动参与率、工资增长及职业晋升。相比之下，灵活安排有助于工作与家庭平衡，但在企业、行业及职业间分布不均。我们提出了一个简洁模型，其中工作不灵活性降低了劳动参与率和生育率，尤其是对母亲而言。我们还对关于灵活性价值、家庭友好政策成本以及将企业行为与生育决策相联系的均衡模型的文献进行了综述。

title: DP11935 Trends and gradients in top tax elasticities: Cross-country evidence, 1900-2014
title_zh: 最高税率弹性的趋势与梯度：跨国证据，1900-2014
title_primary: 最高税率弹性的趋势与梯度：跨国证据，1900-2014
title_secondary: DP11935 Trends and gradients in top tax elasticities: Cross-country evidence, 1900-2014
authors: Enrico Rubolino, Daniel Waldenström
official: 官方在线 2017-03-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We compile data spanning the period 1900–2014 and up to 30 countries to study long-run patterns in the tax elasticity of top incomes. Our results show that top tax elasticities vary tremendously over time; they were medium-to-low before 1950, virtually zero during the postwar era up to 1980 and have thereafter increased to unprecedented levels. We document a strong income gradient in tax response within the top, underlining the importance to study even small top groups separately. Several mechanisms are investigated. Tax-driven income shifting between wage and capital income is important in the very top. Wars, financial crises, and country-specific effects and trends have bearing on top elasticities whereas standard macroeconomic factors and indicators of “real responses” do not.
abstract_zh: 我们汇编了覆盖1900年至2014年、涉及多达30个国家的数据，以研究顶层收入税收弹性的长期模式。结果显示，顶层税收弹性随时间变化极大；1950年前处于中低水平，战后至1980年间几乎为零，此后升至前所未有的高度。我们记录了顶层内部税收反应的显著收入梯度，强调分别研究甚至更小的顶层群体的重要性。我们探讨了多种机制。税收驱动的工资与资本收入之间的转移在顶层尤为显著。战争、金融危机以及国家特定效应和趋势对顶层弹性有影响，而标准宏观经济因素和“实际反应”指标则无显著作用。

title: Training Frontline Health Workers in Low- and Middle-Income Countries to Reduce Contraceptive Stock-Outs: Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 在中低收入国家培训一线卫生工作者以减少避孕药具缺货：来自印度尼西亚的证据
title_primary: 在中低收入国家培训一线卫生工作者以减少避孕药具缺货：来自印度尼西亚的证据
title_secondary: Training Frontline Health Workers in Low- and Middle-Income Countries to Reduce Contraceptive Stock-Outs: Evidence from Indonesia
authors: Amir Karimi, Anant Mishra, Karthik V. Natarajan, Kingshuk K. Sinha, Omar Balsara 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Frontline health workers are an indispensable asset in the healthcare ecosystem of low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). They not only provide clinical care to patients but also frequently shoulder nonclinical responsibilities such as inventory management. However, many lack the necessary skills to effectively manage inventories, leading to the pervasive problem of health commodity stock-outs. To address this problem, several LMICs have launched training programs aimed at enhancing the inventory management skills and capabilities of frontline health workers. Leveraging fine-grained data over a five-year period (2015–2019) from approximately 17,000 health facilities across Indonesia—where the public health supply chain operates as a hybrid push–pull model—we evaluate the impact of a large-scale inventory management training program on contraceptive stock-outs. Applying difference-in-differences estimations, we find that the training program is associated with a significant reduction in stock-outs (i.e., 6.52 percentage points, or approximately 30%). Our numerical calculations suggest that the training program prevents, on average, more than 800 unintended pregnancies and saves 4.25 maternal and newborn lives per 100,000 women of reproductive age within the catchment area of a treated health facility. A counterfactual benefit–cost analysis shows that on-site delivery of the training program (i.e., on the job within a health facility) yields operational and public health benefits that significantly exceed those achieved through off-site delivery (i.e., outside the health facility in a classroom). Our research highlights the practicality and scalability of human-capital-focused interventions in improving health commodity availability and public health outcomes in LMICs. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696 .
abstract_zh: 一线卫生工作者是中低收入国家（LMICs）医疗体系中不可或缺的资产。他们不仅为患者提供临床护理，还经常承担非临床职责，如库存管理。然而，许多人缺乏有效管理库存所需的技能，导致卫生产品缺货问题普遍存在。为解决这一问题，多个中低收入国家已启动旨在提升一线卫生工作者库存管理技能与能力的培训项目。利用印度尼西亚约17,000家卫生机构在五年期间（2015-2019年）的细粒度数据——该国的公共卫生供应链采用混合推拉模式——我们评估了一项大规模库存管理培训项目对避孕药具缺货的影响。通过双重差分估计，我们发现该培训项目与缺货率显著下降相关（即下降6.52个百分点，约30%）。我们的数值计算表明，该培训项目平均可预防超过800例意外怀孕，并在受训卫生机构服务区域内，每10万名育龄妇女中挽救4.25名母婴生命。反事实成本效益分析显示，现场实施培训项目（即在卫生机构内进行在职培训）所产生的运营和公共卫生效益显著超过非现场实施（即在卫生机构外的教室环境中进行培训）。我们的研究强调了以人力资本为重点的干预措施在改善中低收入国家卫生产品可及性和公共卫生结果方面的实用性与可扩展性。本文已被Stefan Scholtes在医疗管理领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696获取。

title: Risk aversion or hedging? CEO superstition beliefs and corporate environmental investment
title_zh: 风险厌恶还是对冲？CEO迷信信念与企业环境投资
title_primary: 风险厌恶还是对冲？CEO迷信信念与企业环境投资
title_secondary: Risk aversion or hedging? CEO superstition beliefs and corporate environmental investment
authors: Chang Liu, Jian Wang, Liangliang Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Superstitious beliefs, as culturally embedded cognitive biases, can influence managerial decision-making. This study examines the impact of CEOs’ zodiac-year superstition on corporate environmental investment. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2008 to 2023, we find that CEOs become more risk-averse during their zodiac years, which leads firms to reduce environmental investment. This negative effect is weaker among younger or long-tenured CEOs and CEOs with academic or overseas backgrounds. It is also attenuated in state-owned firms, firms with low ownership concentration, and firms operating in polluting or capital-intensive industries. Specifically, the negative effect is concentrated in pollution control investments rather than pollution prevention investments. The findings highlight how culturally embedded managerial beliefs shape corporate environmental investment decisions by influencing CEOs’ risk preferences. KEYWORDS: Superstition CEOs zodiac year environmental strategy JEL CLASSIFICATION: M21 M12 Q56
abstract_zh: 迷信信念作为一种文化嵌入的认知偏差，能够影响管理者的决策。本研究考察了CEO本命年迷信对企业环境投资的影响。利用2008年至2023年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们发现CEO在本命年期间变得更加风险规避，从而导致企业减少环境投资。这一负面效应在年轻或任期较长的CEO以及具有学术或海外背景的CEO中较弱。此外，在国有企业、股权集中度较低的企业以及污染密集型或资本密集型行业中，该效应也有所减弱。具体而言，负面效应集中于污染治理投资而非污染预防投资。研究结果凸显了文化嵌入的管理者信念如何通过影响CEO的风险偏好来塑造企业环境投资决策。关键词：迷信；CEO；本命年；环境战略；JEL分类：M21 M12 Q56

title: From laggard to leader: Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in Sub-Saharan African context, 1950–2023
title_zh: 从落后者到领跑者：撒哈拉以南非洲背景下马拉维预期寿命的转变，1950—2023年
title_primary: 从落后者到领跑者：撒哈拉以南非洲背景下马拉维预期寿命的转变，1950—2023年
title_secondary: From laggard to leader: Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in Sub-Saharan African context, 1950–2023
authors: Ben Malinga John (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock, Germany), Souza Emmanuel, Jiaxin Shi (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock, Germany)
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: -Life expectancy has risen substantially across Sub-Saharan African (SSA), but national trajectories have diverged. Malawi represents a striking case of transformation, moving from one of the region’s lowest ranked countries in 1950 to among its leaders in 2023 despite persistent economic stagnation. We examine how age specific mortality changes contributed to Malawi’s exceptional gains in life expectancy and compares its mortality transition with those of other SSA countries. We use age and sex specific mortality data from the 2024 United Nations World Population Prospects for 15 SSA countries between 1950 and 2023. Countries were selected to represent the highest, average, and lowest performing groups in life expectancy at birth in 1950. We analyze trends, decompose changes using the Arriaga method, and estimate potential future gains from eliminating mortality at specific ages. Results show that Malawi recorded the largest increase in life expectancy, gaining 36.2 years for females and 33.2 years for males. Its mortality decline followed a broadly similar age pattern to the region but with exceptional intensity: between 1950 and 1980, two thirds of gains came from childhood mortality reductions, while after 2000, adult survival improvements contributed nearly half. Malawi’s resilience during the HIV/AIDS crisis and rapid post 2000 recovery highlight the combined influence of expanded female education, large scale donor investment, and community-based health programs. Our findings provide the first long term age specific decomposition of Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in comparative SSA context, highlighting the changing age structure of mortality reduction in the region.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区的预期寿命显著提升，但各国轨迹呈现分化。马拉维是一个引人注目的转型案例，尽管经济持续停滞，该国却从1950年该地区排名最低的国家之一，跃升至2023年的领先者之列。我们考察了年龄别死亡率变化如何促进马拉维预期寿命的非凡增长，并将其死亡率转型与其他撒哈拉以南非洲国家进行比较。我们使用2024年联合国《世界人口展望》中1950年至2023年间15个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的年龄和性别别死亡率数据。所选国家代表1950年出生时预期寿命的最高、平均和最低表现群体。我们分析趋势，运用Arriaga方法分解变化，并估算消除特定年龄死亡率的潜在未来收益。结果显示，马拉维的预期寿命增幅最大，女性增加36.2岁，男性增加33.2岁。其死亡率下降遵循与该地区大致相似的年龄模式，但强度异常突出：1950年至1980年间，三分之二的收益来自儿童死亡率下降，而2000年后，成人存活率改善贡献了近一半。马拉维在HIV/AIDS危机期间的韧性及2000年后的快速复苏，凸显了女性教育扩展、大规模捐助者投资和社区健康计划的综合影响。我们的研究首次在撒哈拉以南非洲比较背景下，对马拉维预期寿命转型进行了长期年龄别分解，揭示了该地区死亡率下降年龄结构的动态变化。

title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
title_zh: 财政约束下的房产税与住房配置
title_primary: 财政约束下的房产税与住房配置
title_secondary: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
authors: Joshua Coven, Sebastian Golder, Arpit Gupta, Abdoulaye Ndiaye
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Low property taxes amplify lock-in among elderly homeowners, limiting housing access for young families. Raising them reallocates housing toward the young through two channels: capitalization into lower prices reduces required downpayments for financially constrained buyers, a form of embedded leverage, while higher tax obligations raise holding costs for older owners. In our overlapping generations model, raising California’s property taxes to Texas levels increases young homeownership while decreasing elderly homeownership. Removing step-up basis also lowers elderly homeownership, suggesting their tenure is sustained by bequest tax advantages. The tax treatment of housing shapes housing allocation across generations.
abstract_zh: 低房产税加剧了老年房主的锁定效应，限制了年轻家庭的住房获取。提高房产税通过两条渠道将住房重新分配给年轻人：资本化导致房价下降，从而降低了受财务约束购房者的首付要求，这是一种嵌入式杠杆形式；同时，更高的税负增加了老年房主的持有成本。在我们的世代交叠模型中，将加利福尼亚州的房产税提高至得克萨斯州水平，会增加年轻群体的住房拥有率，同时降低老年群体的住房拥有率。取消递增基税基也会降低老年住房拥有率，表明其居住期限由遗产税优惠所维持。住房的税收处理方式塑造了跨代际的住房分配格局。

title: 新供给创造新需求：市场准入负面清单的消费提振效应研究
title_zh: 新供给创造新需求：市场准入负面清单的消费提振效应研究
title_primary: 新供给创造新需求：市场准入负面清单的消费提振效应研究
authors: 谢贞发, 郭晨阳, 罗芳勇

abstract: 充分释放超大规模市场潜力,是推动经济高质量发展的重要议题。本文采用多时点双重差分模型,系统考察市场准入负面清单制度对居民消费的提振效应。研究发现：第一,该制度对居民家庭消费水平具有显著的提升作用。第二,在供给结构优化路径上,从企业层面看,政策实施后市场竞争加剧,同时企业创新投入有所增加;从行业层面看,企业进入主要集中在服务业,尤其是直接面向居民日常消费的生活性服务业;从家庭层面看,居民消费意愿增强,家庭储蓄率下降。在收入提振路径上,政策带动企业生产扩张和用工需求增加,居民工资性收入提升,消费能力随之增强。第三,异质性分析发现,市场准入负面清单制度的消费提振效应在制度环境较差、服务业发展滞后的地区更为显著。第四,政府干预规模过大会削弱政策效果,而增加一般公共服务支出能有效强化政策效果。本文为深化市场准入负面清单制度改革以促进消费扩容升级、强化供需双侧协同以及优化政府治理和财政支出结构提供了一定的经验参考。

abstract: This paper develops a test for coefficient variability in spatial regressions. The test is designed to have good power for a wide range of persistent patterns of coefficient variation, be applicable in a wide range of spatial designs, and accommodate spatial correlation in regressors and regression errors. The test approximates the locally best invariant test for coefficient stability in a Gaussian regression model with martingale-like coefficient variation under the alternative, and is thus a spatial generalization of the Nyblom (1989) test of coefficient stability in time series regressions.

abstract: We present one of the first systematic audits of cryptocurrency market data quality across leading vendors. We document pervasive mislabeling, identifier instability, and large cross-provider discrepancies in prices, market caps, and volumes. To address these issues, we develop an aggregation method that yields asymptotically correct data by autonomously identifying and filtering unreliable observations. Using this framework, we construct an index to measure data quality over time and a grading system to benchmark providers. Our findings show that data inconsistencies can materially distort empirical research and investment analysis. They highlight possible oversight gaps in the market for crypto data. This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Special Issue on Digital Finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611 .

abstract: We study the rise of nonbank financial intermediation and its implications for systemic risk. We develop a structural network model of banks and nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs) that decomposes intermediation into a capacity channel, driven by bank balance-sheet constraints, and a reliance channel, reflecting NBFI funding reliance. Using U.S. banking confidential supervisory data, we estimate key structural parameters and quantify both channels. We find that fluctuations in bank-NBFI intermediation are primarily explained by the reliance channel, with variation in NBFI fragility emerging as the dominant driver. We show that NBFI intermediation can amplify shocks through funding interconnectedness.

abstract: Estimated risk-neutral rates from canonical affine term structure models are highly sensitive to sample periods. For example, the 5-5 forward risk-neutral rate for September 1981 can differ by 4.6 percentage points (98%) depending on whether the sample starts in 1961 or 1981. Additionally, the estimated response of this rate to high-frequency monetary policy shocks varies by a factor of three, even within the same sample for monetary policy transmission regressions. We propose that a shifting endpoint model can mitigate these issues and provide new estimates of the effects of monetary policy shocks on long-term risk-neutral rates.
abstract_zh: 从规范仿射期限结构模型估计的风险中性利率对样本期间高度敏感。例如，1981年9月的5-5远期风险中性利率，根据样本起始年份为1961年或1981年，可相差4.6个百分点（98%）。此外，该利率对高频货币政策冲击的估计响应，即使在货币政策传导回归的同一样本内，也变化达三倍。我们提出，移动端点模型可缓解这些问题，并为货币政策冲击对长期风险中性利率的影响提供新的估计。

authors: Dimitrije Ruzic
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper reevaluates the longstanding debate on capital-labor substitution by examining the role of external inputs: raw materials, intermediate goods and services, imports, offshoring. Both a meta-analysis (analyzing existing estimates of substitution) and direct estimation (using U.S. data for 1963-2016) indicate that external inputs disproportionately displace labor. These findings imply (1) that the capital-labor ratio responds 40-80% more strongly to the price of labor than to the price of capital, (2) that value added cannot be modeled separably from gross output, and (3) that historical disagreements regarding substitution can be recast as an omitted variable bias involving external inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察外部投入（原材料、中间品与服务、进口、离岸外包）的作用，重新审视了关于资本-劳动替代的长期争论。元分析（对现有替代弹性估计值的系统性分析）与直接估计（基于1963-2016年美国数据）均表明，外部投入对劳动的替代效应尤为显著。这些发现意味着：（1）资本-劳动比对劳动价格的反应强度比对资本价格的反应强度高出40-80%；（2）增加值无法与总产出进行可分离建模；（3）历史上关于替代弹性的分歧可被重新解释为涉及外部投入的遗漏变量偏误。

title: How does relief from mandatory disclosure affect firm investment and growth?
title_zh: 强制性披露豁免如何影响企业投资与增长？

authors: Anantha Divakaruni, Howard Jones, Kazbi Soonawalla
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the effects of time-limited disclosure relief under the Jumpstart Our Business Startups (JOBS) Act of 2012. The Act grants newly public firms up to five years of exemptions, and our results suggest that the fixed duration of this relief, as much as its availability, shapes post-IPO behavior. Using an intention-to-treat design, we compare treated firms with smaller reporting companies whose exemptions are similar but carry no fixed expiry date. Equity issuance by treated firms increases significantly as the deadline nears while debt issuance declines, and cash reserves accumulate over the period. Capital expenditure increases relative to controls in the early post-IPO years, while R&D shows no differential response. As expiry approaches, the differential with the control group in internal investment weakens but cash-financed acquisitions accelerate. This shift in investment composition coincides with deteriorating operating performance and declining market valuations relative to IPO levels. Our post-expiry analysis reveals an abrupt reversal in acquisition activity upon transition to full disclosure while internal investment remains unchanged, supporting the argument that pre-expiry behavior was driven by the regulatory timeline rather than natural firm maturation. We conclude that the duration of regulatory relief is as important as its scope in shaping corporate behavior, and that time-limited exemptions from mandatory disclosure can induce anticipatory firm responses that work against the policy's intended objectives.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了2012年《创业企业扶助法案》（JOBS法案）下限期信息披露豁免的影响。该法案赋予新上市公司最长五年的豁免期，我们的结果表明，这一救济的固定期限与其可用性同样重要，共同塑造了上市后的企业行为。采用意向性治疗设计，我们将受处理公司与作为对照的小型报告公司进行比较，后者的豁免条件相似但无固定到期日。随着截止日期临近，受处理公司的股权发行显著增加，而债务发行减少，现金储备在此期间累积。在上市后初期，资本支出相对于对照组有所增加，而研发支出未表现出差异化反应。随着豁免期临近结束，与对照组相比，内部投资的差异减弱，但现金收购活动加速。这种投资构成的转变与经营业绩恶化和相对于IPO水平的市场估值下降同时发生。我们的豁免期后分析显示，在过渡至全面披露后，收购活动出现急剧逆转，而内部投资保持不变，这支持了豁免期前行为由监管时间表驱动而非企业自然成熟所致的论点。我们得出结论，监管救济的期限在塑造企业行为方面与其范围同等重要，且强制性披露的限期豁免可能引发预期性企业反应，从而违背政策预期目标。

title: Crowd-Sourced Chinese Genealogies as Data for Demographic and Economic History

title_primary: 众包中国家谱作为人口与经济史研究的数据
title_secondary: Crowd-Sourced Chinese Genealogies as Data for Demographic and Economic History
authors: Xue, Melanie Meng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper evaluates the usefulness of crowd-sourced Chinese genealogical data for quantitative research in demography and economic history. I first examine whether genealogies - despite well-known selection biases - produce demographic patterns consistent with established historical knowledge of China. Comparisons with existing studies show that aggregate population-growth trends and sex ratios over time align reasonably well with established demographic and historical findings, suggesting that genealogies, though selective, capture coherent and interpretable patterns. Building on these plausibility checks, the paper argues that the main value of genealogical data lies in their scalability and temporal depth, particularly as crowd-sourced digitization vastly expands the number of available records. These features make genealogies well suited to analyses that leverage variation across regions and over time, an approach that is central in modern economic history.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了众包中国族谱数据在人口学与经济史定量研究中的实用性。我首先考察族谱——尽管存在众所周知的样本选择偏差——是否能够产生与既有中国历史知识相符的人口模式。与现有研究的比较显示，总体人口增长趋势及性别比例随时间的变化与既定的人口学及历史发现相当吻合，这表明族谱虽具选择性，但捕捉到了连贯且可解释的模式。基于这些合理性检验，本文认为族谱数据的主要价值在于其可扩展性和时间深度，尤其是众包数字化极大地扩展了可用记录的数量。这些特性使族谱非常适合利用区域间及时间上的变异进行分析，而这种方法在现代经济史研究中占据核心地位。

title: A Censored Transformed Model for Proportional Outcomes with Boundary Mass and an Application to Loss Given Default Modeling

authors: Qiang, Yuan Christopher, Sigrist, Fabio
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We introduce the zero-one censored transformed normal (ZOC-TN) model for proportional responses with potential probability mass at the boundaries 0 and 1. The model combines a censored Gaussian variable with a two-parameter affine-logit transformation on the interior (0,1). We characterize the transformation parameters, establish large-sample properties, and relate the affine-logit specification to broader classes of interior distributions. Theoretical and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model can capture a wider range of qualitative density shapes than several benchmark models while remaining parsimonious, computationally efficient, and numerically stable. Furthermore, the ZOC-TN model can be extended (i) to account for nonlinearities and interactions in a tree-boosting machine learning framework and (ii) to explicitly model residual spatio-temporal variability. We apply the ZOC-TN model to loss given default (LGD) modeling for a large dataset of U.S. residential mortgages and compare it to multiple benchmark models. We find that a tree-boosted ZOC-TN model with a spatio-temporal frailty Gaussian process delivers the strongest out-of-sample performance, indicating that mortgage losses are shaped by nonlinear covariate effects and by unaccounted-for space-time variation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出零一截断转换正态（ZOC-TN）模型，用于处理边界0和1处可能存在概率质量的成比例响应数据。该模型将截断高斯变量与内部区间(0,1)上的双参数仿射对数比变换相结合。我们刻画了变换参数的特征，建立了大样本性质，并将仿射对数比设定与更广泛的内部分布类别联系起来。理论与实验结果表明，所提模型在保持简洁性、计算高效性和数值稳定性的同时，能够捕捉比若干基准模型更广泛的定性密度形态。此外，ZOC-TN模型可扩展至：（i）在树提升机器学习框架中纳入非线性和交互效应；（ii）显式建模残差的时空变异性。我们将ZOC-TN模型应用于美国住宅抵押贷款大样本数据的违约损失率（LGD）建模，并与多个基准模型进行比较。研究发现，结合时空脆弱性高斯过程的树提升ZOC-TN模型在样本外表现最优，表明抵押贷款损失受非线性协变量效应及未解释的时空变异共同影响。

authors: Ricardo Dahis, Ivan de las Heras, Santiago Saavedra
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-03-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: While deforestation may yield short-term economic gains, it has lasting impacts on climate change, biodiversity, and water systems. The age of political leaders is a key determinant of how these trade-offs are managed. We study closely contested elections in Brazil and show that when a young politician is in power there is less deforestation (p-value .000), lower greenhouse gas emissions (p-value .061), but higher local income (p-value .023). Results are partly explained by young mayors turning over the bureaucracy with younger public servants (p-value .043).
abstract_zh: 尽管森林砍伐可能带来短期经济收益，但它对气候变化、生物多样性和水系统产生持久影响。政治领导人的年龄是管理这些权衡的关键决定因素。我们研究了巴西竞争激烈的选举，并表明当年轻政治家执政时，森林砍伐减少（p值.000），温室气体排放降低（p值.061），但地方收入提高（p值.023）。结果部分归因于年轻市长通过更年轻的公务员实现官僚机构更替（p值.043）。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We employ machine learning methods to identify skill among active bond mutual fund managers. Using a comprehensive dataset of 3,021 unique U.S. bond funds from May 1995 to November 2024, we demonstrate that fund-level and family-level characteristics, particularly past performance metrics, reliably predict future bond fund performance. A prediction-weighted portfolio strategy that goes long the best-10% of funds and short the worst-10% of funds generates monthly abnormal returns of 33 basis points with an information ratio of 27.6%. The outperformance persists for up to 36 months. Holdings-based characteristics do not help to separate good from bad managers. abstract: A principal hires an agent to learn about the cost of a project (experimentation) and then to execute it (production). The agent is privately informed about the probability that the cost is low, with the high-type agent more optimistic than the low type. Learning is modeled as a series of experiments, where the agent privately chooses his effort in each experiment. Due to the joint presence of adverse selection and moral hazard, even the low type can misrepresent his type, shirk during experimentation and earn a rent. In the optimal contract, the principal uses the length and outcome of experimentation as well as the timing of payments to induce effort and screen the agent. The principal may find it optimal to reward the low type after failure in experimentation. We provide sufficient conditions for both success and failure to be rewarded. We show that over-experimentation can be optimal as it reduces the asymmetric information after a series of failed experiments. We also consider whether it may be optimal to separate experimentation and production between two different agents. When the same agent works on both tasks, the principal can leverage the adverse selection rent to mitigate moral hazard. Therefore, integrating experimentation and production is optimal when adverse selection is severe.

abstract: Since the 1974 Safe Drinking Water Act, the U.S. has spent $2 trillion to provide safe drinking water, yet drinking water for 10–20 percent of Americans violates standards. abstract: We study optimal bailout policies amidst banking and sovereign crises. Our model features sovereign borrowing with limited commitment, where domestic banks hold government debt and extend credit to the private sector. Bank capital shocks can trigger banking crises, prompting the government to consider extending guarantees over bank assets. This poses a trade-off: Larger bailouts relax financial frictions and increase output, but increase fiscal needs and default risk (creating a ‘diabolic loop’). Optimal bailouts exhibit clear properties. The fraction of banking losses the bailouts cover is (i) decreasing in government debt; (ii) increasing in aggregate productivity; and (iii) increasing in the severity of banking crises. Even though bailouts mitigate the adverse effects of banking crises, the economy is ex ante better off without bailouts: Having access to bailouts lowers the cost of defaults, which in turn increases the default frequency, and reduces the levels of debt, output, and consumption.

abstract: We study the problem of allocating indivisible commodities, or “objects”, when some of them are privately owned and some are collectively owned. We search for well-behaved rules that are implementable in “obviously dominant equilibrium”, namely, obviously strategy-proof rules (Li, 2017). We start from the you request my house–I get your turn rules (Abdulkadiroǧlu and Sönmez, 1999), the “AS rules”. We ask whether and when they are obviously strategy-proof. When preferences are strict but otherwise unrestricted, and with at least three agents, the AS rules are obviously strategy-proof if and only if there is at most one owner. This disappointing result raises the question whether things would work out better on some restricted preference domains. On the single-peaked domain, we propose a new family of rules and show that not only are these “priority-augmented crawlers” obviously strategy-proof, but also that they satisfy efficiency, the individual endowments lower bounds, group strategy-proofness, weak neutrality, and separability. On the single-dipped domain, we establish a contrasting result: on this subdomain, unlike on the single-peaked domain, the AS rules are obviously strategy-proof.

abstract: With the rapid advancement of corporate Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) ratings, it is crucial to examine their effects on China’s pursuit of ‘New Quality Productive Forces’ from both efficiency-driven and innovation-driven perspectives. This positive effect is achieved through multiple mechanisms, including the alleviation of financing constraints and the mitigation of principal-agent issues. Additionally, media attention serves as a positive moderating factor, strengthening the beneficial impact of ESG ratings on both TFP and green innovation. We also explore the impact of ESG ratings on corporate greenwashing and find that higher ESG ratings substantially lower the likelihood of greenwashing. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the impact of ESG ratings varies across different regional policy environments, industry sectors, and firm characteristics. Notably, the positive effects on TFP and green innovation are more pronounced in regions with Pilot Free Trade Zones (PFTZs) and firms in technology-intensive and capital-intensive sectors, with the magnitude of these effects also being influenced by ownership structure.

title: Antecedents of firm responses to innovation deregulation: evidence from the incrementally modified drug policy in Korea

title_secondary: Antecedents of firm responses to innovation deregulation: evidence from the incrementally modified drug policy in Korea
authors: Hee Jin Mun, Yerim Chung

abstract: The removal of institutional restrictions on innovation can foster industrial growth, but the success of deregulation remains uncertain due to differences in firms’ motivation and capabilities to exploit the opportunities it creates. In the context of the 2008 deregulation of incrementally modified drugs (IMDs) in Korea, we argue that firms’ motivation to develop IMDs depends on their performance relative to aspiration levels, and that their capabilities – specifically, the specialization and scope of knowledge assets – jointly facilitate the launch of IMDs. An empirical analysis of Korean pharmaceutical firms from 2008 to 2017 revealed that firms were more likely to introduce IMDs when their performance was near aspiration levels or when they possessed both diverse and specialized knowledge assets. This study enhances our understanding of the internal factors shaping variations in firms’ responses to innovation deregulation and offers insights for policymakers seeking to promote innovation.

title: Can ESG alleviate the impact of uncertainty on cash holdings?
title_zh: ESG能否缓解不确定性对现金持有的影响？
title_primary: ESG能否缓解不确定性对现金持有的影响？
title_secondary: Can ESG alleviate the impact of uncertainty on cash holdings?
authors: Yuhui Yang, Benjamin Liu, Jen-Je Su
official: 官方在线 2025-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ESG (Environment, Social and Governance) represents a relatively new approach to sustainability, offering potential benefits in enhancing cash management and risk mitigation. Research has shown that during uncertain times, firms increase their cash holdings for precautionary motives. However, high levels of cash may lead to negative consequences for firm performance, such as agency problems. The purpose of this study is to examine whether ESG plays a moderating role in cash holdings during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using U.S. firm-level quarterly data spanning from 2018 to 2021, we find that ESG alleviates the impact of COVID-19 on cash holdings. Furthermore, ESG exerts a greater role in larger firms during uncertain times. Additionally, governance exerted the most significant influence on cash holdings. Moreover, firms with better ESG enhance firm value and lower firm risk. This study has practical implications for investors and executives in understanding the role of ESG during periods of uncertainty.
